name: SafeWindow Sunamganj flood-extent benchmark
region: Sunamganj Sadar, Chhatak, Dowarabazar (Sunamganj and Sylhet districts, Bangladesh)
independence_note: Reference sensors (Chaohu-1, RCM-1) differ from Sentinel-1; the UNOSAT analyses were produced by UNITAR-UNOSAT, not by this team.
split_strategy: Fixed temporal hold-out: both reference dates (25 May, 18 Jun 2022) are test-only. The method has no trained parameters; thresholds were fixed before scoring and not tuned on these dates. Geographic strata: the three upazilas, reported separately.
limitations: Preliminary UNOSAT products, not field validated.
UNOSAT flood extent (not total water extent) is used, because SafeWindow also leaves out permanent water.
